example_en: Cutting carbon emissions is central to environmental policy in many countries.
example_cn: 削减碳排放是许多国家环境政策的核心。
note: 常搭配 environmental protection / pollution / policy，作定语置于名词前

example_en: In the public sector, wages have risen faster than in private firms.
example_cn: 在公共部门，工资涨幅高于私营企业。
note: 常见搭配 public sector 与 private sector，也可说 the service sector

example_en: The interview was recorded in a small studio above the bookshop.
example_cn: 这次采访是在书店楼上一间小小的演播室里录制的。
note: in the studio 指在录音棚、演播室或画室；studio flat 指单间公寓

example_en: Clients who feel listened to are far more likely to return.
example_cn: 感到自己被认真倾听的客户，回头率要高得多。
note: 律所、设计公司的客户多用 client，商店顾客用 customer

example_en: Words often change meaning depending on the context in which they appear.
example_cn: 词语的含义常常随其出现的语境而变化。
note: 搭配 in the context of；out of context 指脱离语境、断章取义

example_en: Before signing anything, ask an attorney to check the small print.
example_cn: 签署任何文件之前，请让律师看看那些小字条款。
note: 美式英语常用 attorney 指律师；attorney general 指总检察长

example_en: Books in this category are aimed at readers with little free time.
example_cn: 这一类图书面向空闲时间不多的读者。
note: 惯用 fall into a category；category 比 kind 更正式，多用于分类

example_en: Anyone caught driving without insurance commits a serious offence.
example_cn: 无保险驾驶者一旦被查，即属严重违法行为。
note: commit an offence 指犯罪；take offence at 意为因某事而生气

example_en: Patience is a valuable asset when you are learning a foreign language.
example_cn: 学习外语时，耐心是一项宝贵的财富。
note: be an asset to 指对某方有益的人或物；assets 指资产

example_en: Membership has doubled since the club began offering evening classes.
example_cn: 自从俱乐部开设晚间课程，会员人数翻了一番。
note: membership of / in a club；membership fee 指会员费

example_en: From the hilltop you can see the whole landscape of fields and rivers.
example_cn: 从山顶望去，田野与河流构成的整片风光尽收眼底。
note: 指较大范围的地貌景色；the political landscape 喻政治格局

example_en: Analysts expect inflation to slow down in the second half of the year.
example_cn: 分析人士预计，今年下半年通胀将有所放缓。
note: 常与 market / financial / data 连用；动词形式为 analyse

example_en: Ignore the warning on the label and the chemical may burn your skin.
example_cn: 若无视标签上的警告，这种化学品可能灼伤皮肤。
note: 搭配 issue a warning；warning sign 指警示信号或征兆

example_en: The course is designed specifically for students who struggle with maths.
example_cn: 这门课专为数学学习吃力的学生开设。
note: be designed specifically for 为常见搭配，语气比 especially 更明确

example_en: Participants were asked to record how many hours they slept each night.
example_cn: 参与者被要求记录自己每晚睡了多少小时。
note: participant in an activity；动词 participate 后面要接 in

example_en: Negotiations between the two companies broke down over the price.
example_cn: 两家公司因价格问题谈崩了。
note: 谈判常用复数 negotiations；break down 指谈判破裂

example_en: Running a small enterprise demands patience as well as capital.
example_cn: 经营小企业既需要资金，也需要耐心。
note: private enterprise 指私营企业；也可指事业心、进取心

example_en: Corporate culture decides whether employees dare to speak out.
example_cn: 企业文化决定了员工是否敢讲真话。
note: 搭配 corporate culture / image / social responsibility

example_en: Price should not be the only criterion when choosing a university.
example_cn: 选择大学时，价格不该是唯一的标准。
note: 单数 criterion，复数为 criteria，不要写成 criterias

example_en: Youth unemployment has fallen for the third month in a row.
example_cn: 青年失业率已连续第三个月下降。
note: the unemployment rate 指失业率；unemployment benefit 指失业救济金

example_en: Experts reckon that online sales will double within five years.
example_cn: 专家估计，网络销售额将在五年内翻一番。
note: 后面常接 that 从句；reckon with 意为应对、考虑到

example_en: With inflation at eight per cent, families are cutting back on meat.
example_cn: 通胀率达到百分之八，许多家庭在减少肉类消费。
note: 搭配 curb / control inflation；inflation rate 指通胀率

example_en: The festival celebrates music from a dozen ethnic groups in the region.
example_cn: 这个节日展现该地区十多个民族的音乐。
note: ethnic group 指族群；ethnic minority 指少数民族

example_en: Initially the treatment worked well, but the symptoms soon returned.
example_cn: 起初治疗效果不错，但症状很快又出现了。
note: 常置于句首并以逗号隔开，与 at first 同义但更书面

example_en: As a Catholic, she attends mass every Sunday morning.
example_cn: 作为天主教徒，她每周日上午都去做弥撒。
note: 指天主教徒时首字母大写；小写 catholic 意为广泛的

example_en: Travellers should change some currency before leaving the airport.
example_cn: 旅客最好在离开机场前兑换一些当地货币。
note: foreign currency 指外币；currency 也可指通用、流行

example_en: A spokesman for the airline apologised for the long delays.
example_cn: 该航空公司的发言人因长时间延误而致歉。
note: a spokesman for 指某机构的发言人；中性说法是 spokesperson

example_en: The show's ratings fell sharply after its main actor left.
example_cn: 主要演员离开后，这档节目的收视率大幅下降。
note: 多用复数 ratings 指收视率、评分；credit rating 指信用评级

example_en: The old regime collapsed after months of street protests.
example_cn: 经过数月街头抗议，旧政权垮台了。
note: 可指政权，也可指固定体制，如 a training regime

example_en: Currently only two of the city's five swimming pools are open.
example_cn: 目前，全市五个游泳池只有两个开放。
note: 常置句首或 be 动词之后，多与进行时和状态连用

example_en: Their new album was recorded live in a concert hall in Vienna.
example_cn: 他们的新专辑是在维也纳一座音乐厅现场录制的。
note: 唱片和相册都用 album；photo album 指相册

example_en: Sooner or later, every government must confront the housing shortage.
example_cn: 任何政府迟早都得面对住房短缺问题。
note: confront a problem 指直面问题；be confronted with 意为面临

example_en: There is no simple mechanism for settling disputes between neighbours.
example_cn: 邻里纠纷并没有什么简单的解决机制。
note: a mechanism for doing sth；也可指机械装置或生理机制

example_en: Since his retirement, he has written two books on gardening.
example_cn: 退休以来，他已经写了两本园艺方面的书。
note: take early retirement 指提前退休；动词 retire from 接职位

example_en: Falling demand pushed the economy into a deep recession.
example_cn: 需求下降把经济推入了严重衰退。
note: fall into / emerge from recession；deep recession 指深度衰退

example_en: Coding is now part of the curriculum in many primary schools.
example_cn: 编程如今已成为许多小学课程的一部分。
note: 复数为 curricula 或 curriculums，指整体课程体系

example_en: Cutting the deficit too quickly may slow down economic growth.
example_cn: 过快削减赤字可能会拖慢经济增长。
note: trade deficit 指贸易逆差；反义词为 surplus，指盈余

example_en: Pregnant women are advised to avoid raw fish and soft cheese.
example_cn: 建议孕妇避免食用生鱼和软质奶酪。
note: be pregnant with 也可喻指孕育着；名词形式为 pregnancy

example_en: How can cities tackle traffic jams without building more roads?
example_cn: 城市怎样才能在不修更多路的情况下解决拥堵？
note: tackle a problem 比 deal with 更强调主动应对

example_en: His presentation lasted twenty minutes and ended with three clear questions.
example_cn: 他的报告讲了二十分钟，最后提出三个明确的问题。
note: give / make a presentation；presentation skills 指表达能力

example_en: Rising interest rates have made mortgages far more expensive.
example_cn: 利率上升使抵押贷款变得昂贵得多。
note: take out / pay off a mortgage；monthly mortgage 指月供

example_en: Talking therapy can be as effective as medicine for mild anxiety.
example_cn: 对轻度焦虑而言，谈话治疗可能与药物同样有效。
note: undergo / receive therapy 指接受治疗；多指非手术的长期治疗

example_en: The report calls for better representation of women on company boards.
example_cn: 这份报告呼吁让更多女性进入公司董事会。
note: representation of 指某群体的代表；动词为 represent

example_en: The two sides will negotiate over working hours and holiday pay.
example_cn: 双方将就工作时间和假日薪酬进行商谈。
note: negotiate with sb over sth；negotiate a deal 指谈成一笔交易

example_en: The job requires a qualification in nursing and two years' experience.
example_cn: 这份工作要求有护理专业资格和两年工作经验。
note: a qualification in 指某领域的资格；也可指保留意见

example_en: The transition from coal to clean energy will take decades.
example_cn: 从煤炭转向清洁能源将需要数十年时间。
note: the transition from A to B；in transition 指处于过渡期

example_en: Nothing changed except the public's perception of how the company behaves.
example_cn: 除了公众对这家公司行为的看法，一切都没有改变。
note: public perception 指公众认知；perception of 指对某事的看法

example_en: Senators from both parties supported the new education bill.
example_cn: 两党参议员都支持这项新的教育法案。
note: 美国参议员称 senator，众议员为 representative

example_en: The defendant sat quietly while the evidence was read aloud.
example_cn: 宣读证据时，被告安静地坐着。
note: 被告为 defendant，原告为 plaintiff；辩方称 the defence

example_en: A coalition of charities is calling for free school meals.
example_cn: 一个由多家慈善机构组成的联盟正呼吁提供免费校餐。
note: a coalition of 指某几方的联合体；coalition government 指联合政府

example_en: The camp provides shelter and schooling for thousands of refugees.
example_cn: 该营地为难民提供住所和上学的机会。
note: refugee camp 指难民营；refuge 是名词，意为避难所

example_en: Doctors look for symptoms before ordering any expensive tests.
example_cn: 医生先寻找症状，再安排昂贵的检查。
note: show / relieve symptoms；symptom of 也可喻指某种征兆

example_en: The airline denied liability for the lost luggage.
example_cn: 航空公司否认对丢失的行李负有责任。
note: accept / deny liability for；复数 liabilities 指债务

example_en: Inspectors found that the building had no working fire alarm.
example_cn: 检查人员发现，这栋楼的火灾报警器全部失灵。
note: 常构成 health / safety inspector；动词为 inspect，指检查

example_en: The school now trains teachers to recognise warning signs of suicide.
example_cn: 学校现在培训教师识别自杀的警示信号。
note: commit suicide 为固定说法；此类话题在写作中宜委婉表达

example_en: Companies that pollute rivers now face a heavy financial penalty.
example_cn: 污染河流的公司如今将面临巨额罚款。
note: impose / pay a penalty；death penalty 指死刑

example_en: Before any treatment begins, patients receive a full assessment.
example_cn: 在治疗开始之前，病人会接受全面评估。
note: make / carry out an assessment of；动词为 assess

example_en: The course is divided into six modules, each lasting two weeks.
example_cn: 这门课程分为六个单元，每个单元历时两周。
note: 大学课程中指单元或模块；软件中也指功能模块

example_en: As a producer of steel, the region depends heavily on export orders.
example_cn: 该地区是钢铁产地，严重依赖出口订单。
note: a producer of 指某物的生产国或生产商；也指电影制片人

example_en: The two universities formed an alliance to share library resources.
example_cn: 两所大学结成联盟，共享图书馆资源。
note: form / enter into an alliance with；in alliance with 指与某方联合

example_en: The clinic runs free classes on healthy eating every Tuesday.
example_cn: 这家诊所每周二开设免费的健康饮食课程。
note: 多指专科诊所或门诊部；综合性医院用 hospital

example_en: Official figures show that immigration has slowed since last year.
example_cn: 官方数据显示，自去年以来移民流入有所放缓。
note: immigration 指移入，emigration 指移出；边检也称 immigration

example_en: We incorporated several of the committee's suggestions into the final plan.
example_cn: 我们把委员会的好几条建议纳入了最终方案。
note: incorporate A into B 指把 A 纳入 B；也可作形容词用

example_en: The dealer agreed to repair the car at no extra cost.
example_cn: 经销商同意免费把这辆车修好。
note: car dealer 指汽车经销商；dealership 指其经销店

example_en: The exhibition attracted little publicity until a critic praised it.
example_cn: 直到一位评论家加以称赞，这个展览才受到关注。
note: attract / seek publicity；publicity campaign 指宣传活动

example_en: Legal proceedings against the firm may last several years.
example_cn: 针对这家公司的诉讼可能持续数年。
note: 法律语境多用复数 proceedings；begin proceedings against 指起诉

example_en: Hospitals rely on consultants to handle the most complex cases.
example_cn: 医院依靠会诊专家处理最复杂的病例。
note: a consultant on sth 指某方面的顾问；动词 consult 指咨询

example_en: The plan works on the premise that oil prices will stay low.
example_cn: 这个方案的前提是油价将保持低位。
note: on the premise that 意为在某个前提下；premises 指房屋场地

example_en: The city will restore several historic buildings along the river.
example_cn: 这座城市将修复河边的几座历史建筑。
note: historic 指有历史意义的，historical 指与历史有关的

example_en: He borrowed a guitar and played a song at the party.
example_cn: 他借了把吉他，在聚会上弹了一首歌。
note: 演奏乐器前加定冠词，如 play the guitar；吉他手为 guitarist

example_en: Employees received compensation after the factory was closed without notice.
example_cn: 工厂未经通知就关停后，员工们获得了补偿。
note: claim / pay compensation for；in compensation for 指作为补偿

example_en: The remark was clearly offensive, and the manager apologised at once.
example_cn: 那番话显然带有冒犯性，经理马上道了歉。
note: find sth offensive 指觉得某话刺耳；也可指进攻性的

example_en: Analysts expect the firm's earnings to grow by ten per cent.
example_cn: 分析人士预计，这家公司的收益将增长百分之十。
note: earnings 常用复数，指公司收益或个人工资收入

example_en: Poor housing and low wages together constitute a serious social problem.
example_cn: 住房条件差、工资低，合起来构成了严重的社会问题。
note: constitute a threat / problem；比 make up 更正式

example_en: She keeps a low profile and rarely speaks to journalists.
example_cn: 她保持低调，很少同记者讲话。
note: keep a low profile 指保持低调；high profile 指高调、受关注

example_en: For years the firm has been the dominant supplier of farm machinery.
example_cn: 多年来，这家公司一直是农业机械的主要供应商。
note: play a dominant role 指起主导作用；名词为 dominance

example_en: He took her advice literally and bought forty kilograms of flour.
example_cn: 他照字面理解她的建议，买了四十公斤面粉。
note: take sth literally 指照字面理解；口语中也用作强调

example_en: This year marks the fiftieth anniversary of the school's founding.
example_cn: 今年是该校建校五十周年。
note: celebrate / mark an anniversary；前面常接序数词

example_en: Students receive a small allowance to cover books and transport.
example_cn: 学生可以领到一小笔补助，用于书籍和交通。
note: make allowance for 指考虑到、体谅；也可指零用钱

example_en: After the promotion, she was responsible for a team of twelve.
example_cn: 升职之后，她负责一支十二人的团队。
note: get / deserve a promotion 指获得晋升；sales promotion 指促销

example_en: It was her firm conviction that hard work would be rewarded.
example_cn: 她坚信努力终会得到回报。
note: with conviction 指坚定地；法律义则指定罪

example_en: Security was tightened after a terrorist attack on the airport.
example_cn: 机场遭到恐怖袭击后，安保措施加强了。
note: terrorist attack 为常见搭配；抽象名词为 terrorism

example_en: There is no simple recipe for success in language learning.
example_cn: 语言学习要想成功，并没有什么简单的诀窍。
note: a recipe for sth 既可指食谱，也可喻指诀窍或原因

example_en: The new law makes assault on emergency workers a serious crime.
example_cn: 新法规定，袭击急救人员属于严重犯罪。
note: an assault on sb 指对某人的袭击，比 attack 更书面

example_en: Monetary policy alone cannot solve the problem of slow growth.
example_cn: 单靠货币政策无法解决增长乏力的问题。
note: monetary policy 指货币政策；monetary value 指金钱价值

example_en: Could you send the file again? The printer jammed twice.
example_cn: 能不能再发一次文件？打印机卡了两次纸。
note: 指打印机或印刷工；print out 指把文件打印出来

example_en: The council imposed sanctions on firms that broke the rules.
example_cn: 该理事会对违规公司实施了制裁。
note: impose / lift sanctions on；作动词时也可指批准

example_en: Whether to ban cars from the centre remains a matter of controversy.
example_cn: 市中心是否禁止汽车通行仍是一个有争议的问题。
note: a matter of controversy；cause / spark controversy 指引发争议

example_en: Very few historians now accept that early account of the battle.
example_cn: 如今很少有历史学家采信那则早期的战事记载。
note: 由 history 加 -ian 构成；注意与 historic 区分

example_en: The detective worked late into the night, comparing the two statements.
example_cn: 侦探工作到深夜，仔细比对了那两份陈述。
note: detective novel / story 指侦探小说；也可作定语修饰名词

example_en: Posting someone's private photos online may violate their rights.
example_cn: 在网上发布他人私密照片可能侵犯其权利。
note: violate the law / rules / rights；名词形式为 violation

example_en: The drug is safe in clinical trials but causes mild headaches.
example_cn: 这种药在临床试验中是安全的，但会引起轻微头痛。
note: clinical trials / tests 指临床试验；也可指冷静客观的

example_en: Children under five are especially vulnerable to this infection.
example_cn: 五岁以下的儿童尤其容易感染这种疾病。
note: be vulnerable to 指易受某事物伤害；名词为 vulnerability

example_en: Understanding consumer psychology helps shops arrange their goods better.
example_cn: 了解消费者心理有助于商店更好地摆放商品。
note: 派生词 psychologist 指心理学家，psychological 指心理的

example_en: Without early intervention, the child's reading difficulties may worsen.
example_cn: 若不及时干预，孩子的阅读困难可能进一步加重。
note: early / government intervention；动词为 intervene in

example_en: The family filed a lawsuit against the hospital last week.
example_cn: 这家人上周对医院提起了诉讼。
note: file / bring a lawsuit against sb；与动词 sue 意思相近

example_en: Her testimony helped the court understand what happened that night.
example_cn: 她的证词帮助法庭了解那天晚上发生了什么。
note: give / hear testimony；动词为 testify，指作证

example_en: It is incredible how quickly the children adapted to the new school.
example_cn: 孩子们适应新学校的速度之快，令人难以置信。
note: It is incredible how / that 句型；副词 incredibly 指极其

example_en: She was a fighter who refused to let illness define her life.
example_cn: 她是个斗士，绝不让疾病定义自己的人生。
note: 可指战士、战斗机，也喻指顽强的人，如 firefighter

example_en: The lease expires in June, so they may have to move.
example_cn: 租约六月到期，他们可能不得不搬家。
note: sign / renew a lease；作动词时表示出租或租用
